resources.string: Mysone listens in the background, transcribes on your phone and organizes what it hears into conversations with a date and time.
Transcribes on the phone, without sending the audio anywhere.
Groups what it hears into conversations and lets you search all of them.
With AI (optional): summaries, tasks, reminders and answers to your questions.
It doesn\'t keep audio: it\'s deleted as soon as it\'s transcribed.
It doesn\'t send anything to the internet unless you turn on AI.
It doesn\'t record calls (it does transcribe the ones your phone records) or tell voices apart while listening live.
Mysone listens continuously while you see its notification, transcribes on the phone and deletes the audio. It stores text with a date and time.
Only conversations you take part in.

Laws differ between countries. In many places you may keep conversations you take part in, but recording other people\'s conversations (someone else\'s call, the table next to you) can be a crime. If you leave your phone in a room without you, pause listening.
Especially at work or with clients: data protection rules apply there.
Sharing them may violate other people\'s privacy even if the conversation was yours.
No audio, and on your phone.
By default nothing leaves your phone. If you turn on AI, you\'ll see what is sent and to whom.
Pause and forget whenever you like.
From the notification or from Today. “Forget” deletes the last few minutes.
I\'ve read the notice and will use Mysone only in conversations I take part in.
Mysone needs the microphone to listen. While it\'s listening you\'ll see a persistent notification and Android\'s microphone indicator; from the notification you can pause or stop.
I can\'t listen without the microphone. You can grant it in the system settings.
They let us alert you about your reminders and if listening stops. They only show the text of each reminder, never the transcript.
Without notifications you won\'t see reminders or the alert that listening has stopped. You can turn them on in the system settings.
Transcription runs on your phone with a model that\'s downloaded just once.
Your phone has %1$d GB of RAM.
If there\'s no Wi-Fi right now, the download will wait.
The download continues even if you move on.
Without AI, Mysone transcribes, organizes and searches. With AI, it also summarizes each conversation, pulls out tasks and reminders, and answers your questions about what you\'ve heard.
You need an API key from a provider (Anthropic, Mistral or another compatible one). Text from your transcripts is sent, never the audio, and you\'ll see who gets it first.
It\'s turned off. You can set it up whenever you like in Settings › AI.
When you start, you\'ll see the Mysone notification. You can pause or stop from it or from Today.
When everything is ready, tap Listen in Today.
It listens while you see its notification.
Start it from Today. The ongoing notification lets you pause or stop at any time, and “Forget” deletes the last few minutes.
Audio is turned into text on the phone and then deleted. After a stretch of silence, what was heard becomes a dated conversation in Today.
Search finds words across all your transcripts, even offline.
With AI: summaries, tasks and answers.
Each conversation gets a title and a summary, tasks and reminders go to Tasks, useful facts go to Memory, and in Ask you can ask about what you talked about, with a link to each conversation.
Your calls and audio files too.
Android doesn\'t let apps record calls, but if your phone records them, Mysone can transcribe them. You can also import audio files. Set it up in Settings › Transcription.
Choose how you want Mysone to work. Each option is saved as soon as you tap it.
You can change all of this later in Settings.
Do you want to use AI?
